title: veronica ciliolata subsp. fiordensis
intro: Veronica ciliolata subsp. fiordensis, commonly known as Fiord Veronica, is a plant species found in New Zealand. It is a flowering plant that belongs to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). The health benefits of Veronica ciliolata subsp. fiordensis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as digestive issues and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, that exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
